QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] A Private Meeting
QuestInfo.0: The route between Katanos and Pente is increasingly dangerous for the residents of Helia... Go and--wait, who is that?
QuestInfo.1: You've promised to have dinner with #p9201714# and #p9201720# to celebrate your appointment as captain. But then #p9201725# arrived with some Faint Darkness... How can darkness exist in Helia? When you reported it to #p9201713#, he told you of the prophecy of Hielo's creation. Search for more evidence of darkness across Helia.
QuestInfo.2: The monster you encountered on the road to Katanos chased you all the way to Pente. Apparently it ran in the direction of Duo... You decided to find Lewin.
